brand.merchant_action: Supply the brand name for the product.
brand.why_it_matters: An agent cannot identify the brand of the product.

dimensions_present.merchant_action: Supply the product length, width, and height.
dimensions_present.why_it_matters: An agent cannot compare size in length, width, and height.

fit_structured.merchant_action: Add fit as a structured product attribute, using the exact fit note from the description, or supply the correct fit note if the description is wrong.
fit_structured.what_is_missing: Fit is in the product description, but it is not a structured field.
fit_structured.why_it_matters: An agent cannot compare fit reliably when it is only in prose.

gtin.merchant_action: Supply the GTIN, if the product has one.
gtin.what_is_missing: No GTIN is in the product record.
gtin.why_it_matters: An agent cannot match the product across stores by GTIN.

image_alt.merchant_action: Supply alt text that describes the photo.
image_alt.what_is_missing: The product image has no alt text.
image_alt.why_it_matters: An agent cannot describe the photo to a buyer.

json_ld_product_schema.merchant_action: No action is required from this audit item. A separate schema check is needed to verify it.
json_ld_product_schema.what_is_missing: Product schema was not checked by this audit.
json_ld_product_schema.why_it_matters: This audit does not claim schema is present or absent, so no merchant action is claimed here.

material_structured.merchant_action: Add material as a structured product attribute, using the exact material from the description, or supply the correct material if the description is wrong.
material_structured.what_is_missing: Material is in the product description, but it is not a structured field.
material_structured.why_it_matters: An agent cannot compare material reliably when it is only in prose.

mentioned_option_not_selectable.merchant_action: Add that option as a selectable variation online, or remove the mention from the online description.
mentioned_option_not_selectable.what_is_missing: An option is mentioned in the description, but it cannot be selected online.
mentioned_option_not_selectable.why_it_matters: An agent cannot offer an option the buyer cannot select.

returns_structured.merchant_action: Add returns terms as a structured field, using the exact terms from the description, or supply the correct terms if the description is wrong.
returns_structured.what_is_missing: Returns terms are in the product description, but they are not a structured field.
returns_structured.why_it_matters: An agent cannot tell the buyer the return terms reliably when they are only in prose.

shipping_info.merchant_action: Supply shipping rates and policy at checkout level, where shipping is set.
shipping_info.what_is_missing: No shipping rates or shipping policy are in the product record.
shipping_info.why_it_matters: An agent cannot quote shipping for the product.

stock_quantity.merchant_action: Supply the numeric stock quantity, if the store tracks it.
stock_quantity.what_is_missing: Only a yes or no stock flag is present. No numeric stock quantity is present.
stock_quantity.why_it_matters: An agent cannot tell how many units are left.

tags.merchant_action: Add relevant tags for the product.
tags.why_it_matters: An agent cannot group or find the product by tag.

tax_info.merchant_action: Supply the tax rule at checkout level, where tax is set.
tax_info.what_is_missing: No tax rate or tax rule is in the product record.
tax_info.why_it_matters: An agent cannot quote tax for the product.

weight_present.why_it_matters: An agent cannot compare weight, and shipping estimates cannot use weight.
